propositions: Provider qualification currently uses shape regex testing (prefix matching `^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*$`) instead of membership in a known registry, causing typos like 'bedrok' to be silently accepted at config time rather than rejected

Colon-containing model IDs like `anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0` are incorrectly treated as already-qualified because the shape test looks only at prefix shape, not whether the prefix is an actual provider name
The shape regex rejects valid provider names containing slashes (e.g., `gateway/openai`, `gateway/bedrock`) because it requires alphanumerics and hyphens only
Configuration-time validation of explicitly configured provider values must fail fast with a named error message, not defer to provider construction time

A static frozenset of 24 known provider names (from pydantic-ai's registry) must replace the shape regex, with membership used for explicit providers and permissive fallthrough for unknown inline prefixes to preserve colon-bearing model IDs
